subject: Purchase ID format, invoice consolidation cadence, and net-term request
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medscale.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medscale.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@medscale.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick: PO ID format + request for extended terms and consolidated invoices

Hi Priyom,

Thanks for the run-through last week — the team appreciated the demo. A couple of procurement constraints came up on our side as we try to align Redwood with MedScale's ERP:

- We need every invoice to include a Purchase Order identifier that follows our internal format: MS-<entity>-<YYYYMM>-<4digit>. Example: MS-HR-202709-0123. Can you confirm you can surface that as the primary invoice reference (not just in line items)?
- Our AP team prefers consolidated weekly invoices rather than individual invoices per usage event (they use a weekly cutoff for ledger reconciliation). Is Redwood able to support a weekly statement cadence?
- Finally, our finance lead asked if you can extend to Net 45 or Net 60 for the first 90 days of the pilot; standard policy is Net 30. We can provide a blanket PO for the quarter if that helps.

I've attached our PO template for reference. Can you loop in whoever owns billing?

Appreciate it,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Procurement Manager, MedScale Health
agomez@medscale.com
+1 415-555-0189

Attachment: MedScale_PO_template.csv

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alicia Gomez <agomez@medscale.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 28 Sep 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: PO ID format + request for extended terms and consolidated invoices

Hi Alicia — thanks for the detail and the template, that helps. Quick answers and next steps below. Looping Ben (billing ops) and Vanessa (account exec) to confirm on discounts/commit.

- PO identifier: We can put the MS- prefix string into the invoice "Invoice Reference" field so it appears at the top of every PDF and in the accounting metadata we send back to you. Our billing system will accept the format you shared; we'll map MS-<entity>-<YYYYMM>-<#####> to our invoice_reference and po_number fields.
- Consolidated weekly statements: Redwood's hosted billing can produce weekly consolidated statements (cutoff Sunday 23:59 UTC or configurable). We'll need to confirm the timezone and cutoff you'd like and whether you want a single PDF with line-level usage or a CSV export to feed your ERP.
- Net terms: Standard is Net 30. We can offer Net 45 for the first 90 days of a paid pilot if MedScale commits to a minimum monthly usage level (see attached Pricing_Tier_Schedule.xlsx). Ben — can you confirm the minimum spend threshold and whether finance approvals are needed for Net 45?

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben to confirm spend threshold + attachment of amended SOW with payment terms.
2) MedScale confirms preferred weekly cutoff (timezone + day).
3) We'll produce a sample weekly statement with the MS- prefix mapping for you to validate before go-live.

Thanks — talk soon.
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Pricing_Tier_Schedule.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@medscale.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: PO ID format + request for extended terms and consolidated invoices

Thanks Priyom — confirming internal constraints here.

- Minimum commit for Net 45: For pilot customers we can approve Net 45 for the first 90 days with a $15k monthly minimum commit (applies to hosted usage only). If MedScale prefers Net 60, that would require an elevated commit or prepay.
- Discount/packaging: If MedScale signs a quarterly blanket PO (preferred), we can lock the pricing in Table A of the attached SOW and provide an introductory 5% commitment discount for the quarter. That discount is contingent on the PO being in place before the pilot start.
- Weekly consolidation: we'll produce both a PDF statement and a CSV export. For ERP ingest we recommend the CSV; we'll include invoice_reference (MS-... value), account_code, usage_rows, and the per-line charge.

Priyom — I'll draft the amended SOW with Net 45 and the 5% conditional discount and share for signature. Vanessa, can you confirm commercial approval for the 5%?

Ben Carter
Director, Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>, Alicia Gomez <agomez@medscale.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: PO ID format + request for extended terms and consolidated invoices

Hi all — commercial ok on the conditional 5% introductory discount for the quarter if MedScale provides a blanket PO and agrees to the $15k/month minimum for Net 45. We should also call out the rollback: if actual usage falls below 80% of the committed monthly amount for two consecutive months, standard Net 30 and list pricing will resume. Priyom — please add that clause into the SOW draft.

Alicia — can you confirm whether your AP team will accept a CSV line export and whether the week cutoff should be Sunday 11:59pm PST (same as Pacific Time close of business) or Sunday 23:59 UTC? That affects our reconciliation timeframe.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vanessa@redwoodinference.com

From: Tom Reed <tom.reed@medscale.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick: PO ID format + request for extended terms and consolidated invoices

Vanessa / Priyom / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming MedScale accepts the conditional terms:

- We will issue a blanket quarterly PO by close of business Oct 4 containing MS-HR-202710-0001 (and a reference table for subsequent entity codes).
- AP prefers the CSV export for ERP ingest. Cutoff: Sunday 23:59 UTC aligns better with our global ops (so please use UTC).
- We accept the $15k/month minimum for Net 45 for the first 90 days and the 5% intro discount, subject to the rollback clause you outlined.

Please send the amended SOW and the sample weekly statement for our AP validation. Once we sign the SOW and deliver the PO, we'll route the DocuSign.

Tom Reed
VP Finance, MedScale Health
tr@medscale.com

Forwarded attachments: SOW_Redwood_MedScale_v2.pdf, MedScale_PO_template.csv
